name: @absolutejs/meeting
description: Meeting-bot core for AbsoluteJS — join a call (via a source adapter), transcribe it live with the voice scribe, and surface diarized turns + participants for analysis
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root src --target bun --external @absolutejs/manifest --external '@absolutejs/manifest/*' --external @absolutejs/voice --external '@absolutejs/voice/*' --external @sinclair/typebox --external '@sinclair/typebox/*' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run verify-package && bun run build && absolute-changelog check
